headline: Tech slipped Friday as oil and yields rose; weekend Houthi claims of Saudi oil attacks add risk.
brief: The Nasdaq Composite fell 0.2% Friday to 25,955, closing mid-range, as Brent hit a six-month high and the 10-year yield rose about 4 bp to near 5%. No major Asia data is scheduled tonight, so oil and Middle East headlines after unconfirmed Houthi claims of attacks on Saudi sites are the main driver into a week with the FOMC, BOJ and mega-cap earnings. Key risk is an oil spike at the reopen pushing yields higher.

sources.title: How major US stock indexes fared Friday 10/23/2026
